Subject: POC trial environment options - Acme AI

Hi Alex / Samantha,

Thanks again for the product demo earlier - great conversation. As promised, quick written recap of the POC options and proposed plan so we can lock timelines and owners. Please confirm and flag anything I missed.

Goal / success criteria (customer-provided):
- Demonstrate that Redwood can serve Acme AI's chat assistant with <= 250ms median latency for 512-token requests at 20 RPS.
- End-to-end throughput to support batch offline embedding jobs (50k docs/day) with acceptable cost per embedding.
- Verify compatibility with Acme's data controls (KMS + audit logs) and network requirements.

Evaluation plan / metrics:
- Day 0-7: deploy sandbox, run synthetic latency/throughput tests, validate KV/prefix caching behavior.
- Day 8-14: run representative traffic and sample data (10k docs) to validate cost and quality.
- Day 15-21: integration tests with your staging connector + final performance verification.

Environment options (we discussed three):
1) Hosted trial (Redwood-hosted sandbox)
   - Fastest to start (hours), includes telemetry and dashboards, limited isolation. Good for latency/cost benchmarks and quality checks.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity)
   - Provisioned GPU pool for more predictable throughput and isolation for multi-hour sustained tests. Requires a short provisioning lead time (1-3 business days).
3) VPC trial (customer VPC with private connectivity)
   - Full network isolation, supports KMS/HSM integration and private peering. Requires network prep (CIDR, firewall rules, VPN/peering) and an engineer touch (3-7 business days prep).

Immediate ask / ownership:
- Acme: confirm success criteria above and provide contact for networking/security (name + email).
- Redwood (Marissa): I'll coordinate scheduling and commercial items.
- Redwood (Monica): will run tech kickoff and own environment provisioning.

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm which environment you prefer for the POC (hosted / dedicated / VPC) by EOD Thu 6/25.
- If VPC: please share temporary CIDR range and your security contact so Monica can draft the network checklist.
- I'll attach a short PoC runbook and a hosted vs VPC comparison matrix for reference (attached).

Attachments: PoC Runbook v1.pdf, Hosted-vs-VPC-matrix.xlsx

Thanks - looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,

Thanks Marissa - helpful summary. Quick answers / questions from our side: 

- We like the idea of starting with the hosted trial to move fast and then switch to VPC if security checks out.
- Success criteria: 250ms median at 20 RPS is our target; also would like 95th percentile < 600ms.
- Data residency: our production data is in us-west-2; for the hosted sandbox, can you confirm region and whether logs will be stored outside our tenancy?
- Throughput: sample dataset for initial validation will be ~10k docs; for embedding runs we expect bursts up to 50k docs/day. Can the hosted sandbox handle that for short window tests or should we start with Dedicated?

Also looping in Samantha (security) - Samantha, can you be our point for network/KMS questions?

Thanks,
Alex

Hi Alex - thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications from the infra/SE side: 

Hosted sandbox (recommended start)
- Region: we can spin up the hosted sandbox in us-west-2. Logs and telemetry are stored in Redwood's customer-scoped storage for the trial; we can enable log redaction and limited retention (configurable). For formal audit access we can provide export snapshots.
- Throughput: hosted sandbox can handle your 10k doc tests and short bursts up to 50k docs/day; sustained high-throughput embedding pipelines are better on Dedicated.

Dedicated sandbox
- Best for sustained load testing and more predictable tail-latency under sustained concurrency. Provisioning lead time 1-3 business days.

VPC trial (requirements)
- Required from Acme: CIDR range for the Peered/Private interface, shortlist of committed egress IPs (if you prefer IP allowlisting), and your KMS key ARN for envelope encryption.
- Networking: we support AWS VPC peering and AWS PrivateLink. If you choose VPN, we need your endpoint IP and PSK.
- IAM/service accounts: please create a service principal for the trial that we can use for secure ingestion (we can provide a minimal IAM policy).
- Ports: outbound 443 to our control plane and specific egress to S3 endpoints for model artifacts (we'll provide exact rules).

Docs/Artifacts attached: PoC Runbook v1.pdf (step-by-step), Hosted-vs-VPC-matrix.xlsx (feature/ops differences).

Proposed schedule
- Tech kickoff: Tue 6/30, 30-45m (Monica + Alex + Samantha).
- Host sandbox up: same day as kickoff (hours).
- Dedicated provisioning: if chosen, +1-3 business days after kickoff.

I'll send a short network checklist and an IAM policy snippet after you confirm the environment. Happy to do a quick call to walk through the checklist.
